tools.name: list_active_deals
tools.description: List currently active flash-sale deals from Heartly merchants (see merchant_verified per deal). Returns deals sorted by ending soonest. Filters are optional and combinable.

tools.name: search_deals_by_category
tools.description: Search active deals filtered by category. The category argument is required. Other filters (country, min_discount_pct, ending_within_hours) are optional.

tools.name: get_deal_by_id
tools.description: Look up a single active deal by its Heartly internal id (UUID).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_active_deals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
